name: Texas Roadhouse 6 oz Hand-Cut Sirloin (Plain, No Seasoning, No Butter)
whyItWorks: Texas Roadhouse center-cut sirloin is remarkably lean and tender. Ordering it grilled completely plain without their signature seasoning (which contains garlic, onion, and black pepper) and without butter makes it an ultra-safe, high-protein restaurant anchor.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: '6 oz Sirloin, grilled completely dry and plain—NO steak seasoning, NO butter brush, seasoned with only salt.' Pair with a plain baked potato.
